name: family-heritage
description: Family Heritage Platform - preserve a family's lineage, photographs and stories.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: npm run shared:build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm:api:dev" "npm:web:dev"
scripts.dev:shared: npm run shared:build && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:shared:dev" "npm:api:dev" "npm:web:dev"
scripts.build: npm run shared:build && npm run build --workspace @fh/api && npm run build --workspace @fh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared:build && npm run typecheck --workspace @fh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @fh/web
